test_relabel_no_duplicated_method: test Series.agg with keyword relabeling using single aggregation method per name
test_relabel_duplicated_method: test Series.agg with keyword relabeling using same method assigned to different output names
test_agg_single_relabel: test df["A"].agg(foo="sum") returns equivalent result to df["A"].agg({"foo": "sum"})
test_agg_multiple_relabel: test df["B"].agg(foo=sum, bar=min, cat="max") returns equivalent result to dict-style relabeling
test_agg_same_method_different_names: test df["A"].agg(foo="sum", bar="sum") produces separate series entries with same computed value
